scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: You have too many items. Please make room in your inventory and come back.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: Wow~ Finally!! It's the season we've all been waiting for!

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: It's RWC time!
What is RWC?
Are you a New Agent?
I don't care.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: You must be a new adventurer. I will kindly explain it to you.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: It seems you've traveled quite enough but you're not good with hearing the news around the world.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: There are few adventurers in Midgard whose lives are dedicated to battle, who never skip their training, live in seclusion, and are experts in their art.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: The RWC is the festival where those adventurers can compete with each other and find out who is the best!

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: But this cannot be achieved all alone. Your friends will have a huge role in the competition.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: If you're interested in this festival, start looking for friends you can trust!

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: Many events are organized for RWC promotion every year.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: And this year, a special mission has been entrusted to a new agent... myself!

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: I am supposed to attach blue cards with the letters RWC2011 all over the world to promote the event. But... but...
- He thought of something and then looked at your eyes. -

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: Would you like to listen to my story?
Sure, let me hear it.
No, thank you.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: Arrgg!! Are you ignoring me because I'm new? Usually people listen...
- New Agent is looking at you with pitiable eyes. -
- His brimming small eyes seem to tell you something. ^FF0000Please talk to me again...^000000 -

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: This is my first mission but people's reaction is not good.
- New Agent is looking at you with pitiable eyes. -
- His twinkling small eyes seem to tell you something. ^FF0000Please talk to me again...^000000 -

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text:
I used to be a very normal boy in Morocc.
I am not an adventurer and I don't even know how to buy/sell things. Sometimes I'm just very happy to see adventurers. You know... I am just an ordinary boy.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text:
People used to tell me that since I was very shy.
I would spend my life in a suburb.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text:
But eventually, my patience and restrained personality motivated me to become an agent for RWC2011!
I was so happy that I couldn't sleep! I would finally have a chance to meet lots of adventurers and get to know them.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text:
This mission was so important to me,
I was afraid of being attacked by monsters when attaching the blue cards for RWC2011 in the streets.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text:
And you know what?
^FF0000It really happened!^000000
Are you serious!?

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text:
I had turned off the light and was trying to get some sleep, then I saw this bright light through the window.
Suddenly, the window was broken and it appeared!
It?

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: It was a shining poring! And it ate all blue cards I had prepared in less than a second!

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: I was so shocked, I tried to calm down and think... I had neither heard about nor seen any shining poring!

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: ^FF0000Yes! It must be a dream!^000000 That's the conclusion I came up with and went back to sleep.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: But it wasn't a dream. When I woke up, I realized all the blue cards were gone...

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: If I ruin this promotion, I might lose the job and have to go back to where I used to live alone...

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: If you see the Golden Poring, could you please find the precious blue cards for me?
- He looks at you with imploring eyes. -
Ok, I will help you!
How much money can you offer me?

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: Have you decided to help me? Well, I will prepare some gifts. I'm sure you'll like them.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: What you are looking for are large cards with the letters ^FF0000RWC2011^000000. Some of them might already be digested though.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: Try to gather remaining cards until you make the word, 'RWC2011'.

scripts.speaker: New Agent
scripts.text: Please help me out!! My life is in your hands!

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text: Have you gathered all the cards?

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text: Wow~ You bring light in my life again!

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text: Here are the gifts I promised... Let's see...

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text: It's not much but please keep it! Haha, we still have lots of cards to be found. I hope you can help me tomorrow as well.

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text: Thank you!! I can continue working now. Nothing is impossible when we have great adventurers like you in this world!

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text: ADIOS!
- Agent muttered something to himself. -

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text: Mmmm~ not yet? We're short-handed... Please help me.

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text: I'm just saying that out of concern for you. You need TWO ^FF0000Blue 1 Card^000000. It's "2011"... Got it?

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text:
First, I will start attaching cards you found... I'll take the rest of cards tomorrow.
Please come back tomorrow.

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text:
Thanks for the last time.
I must keep on promoting the event so I want to ask you again~!

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text:
You've come again~
Thanks for the last time! We still have lots of cards to find. Could you help me out?
Ok!
I'm busy now.

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text:
It's the same mission as before.
Try to gather blue cards and make the word, ^FF0000R W C 2 0 1 1 ^000000.
Good Luck!

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text:
...I see...
I still have lots of cards to find so if you have time, please come back and help again.

scripts.speaker: RWC2011 Agent
scripts.text:
... huh...?
I am... a new agent.
